clean_repro.probe: POST /v2/vectordb/entities/search collectionName=test_hnsw_ef data=[[0.1,0.2,0.3]] annsField=vector limit=10 searchParams={"ef": 0}

verified_assumptions: Raw request explicitly provides search parameter ef=0
HNSW index type requires ef ≥ 1 for correct search operation
API returns successful response despite invalid parameter value

contract_refs: constraint_id: milvus_hnsw_ef_validation - HNSW ef parameter must be ≥ 1 (established by HNSW algorithm semantics, see constraints.go: HNSWMinEfConstruction = 1)
contract_grounding.note: While structured_contract.json does not explicitly enumerate ef search-time constraints, index parameter validation logic in internal/util/indexparamcheck/constraints.go defines HNSWMinEfConstruction = 1, establishing the minimum valid ef range for HNSW operations

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: SearchRequest → task_validator.validate() → only checks MaxResultEntries | parseSearchInfo() → extracts searchParams but never validates ef range | No CheckSearch() interface exists for search-time parameter validation
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:IndexChecker 接口只有 CheckTrain (建索引时校验 efConstruction)/CheckValidDataType/StaticCheck,完全没有 CheckSearch() 方法来校验搜索时参数。Proxy 层的 parseSearchInfo() 只是提取 searchParamStr 透传,不做任何 ef 参数范围检查。这是真缺陷 —— API 应该拒绝 ef=0/ef=-1 但实际上接受了这些非法值并返回 HTTP 200。

falsification.probe: Independent verification: curl with ef=0, ef=-1, ef=100 all return HTTP 200 with valid search results
falsification.observed: All three requests succeed despite ef=0 and ef=-1 being mathematically invalid for HNSW algorithm (ef must be ≥ 1 for candidate list size). API behavior violates HNSW parameter contract.

excluded: Environment issue (tested on clean Milvus v2.6.10 instance)
Request parameter typo (verified exact JSON syntax)
Approximate search by-design (HNSW is approximate but still requires ef ≥ 1)

cognition_match.developer_quote: REST v2 API fails to properly serialize/deserialize complex data types (26 instances in corpus, confidence 0.95)
cognition_match.note: This defect extends the REST v2 parameter validation gap to HNSW search-time parameters. While bug_shape records focus on data type serialization, the same root cause (missing parameter validation in REST v2 layer) applies to numeric parameter ranges like ef.

verdicts.rationale: 源码接地 + 双盲复现均确认缺陷:IndexChecker 接口只提供 CheckTrain() (建索引时校验 efConstruction ∈ [1, 2147483647]),完全没有 CheckSearch() 方法校验搜索时 ef 参数。Proxy 层 parseSearchInfo() 提取 searchParamStr 后直接透传,不做范围检查。实测证实:POST /entities/search 带 searchParams={"ef": 0} 或 {"ef": -1} 均返回 HTTP 200 + 正常搜索结果,违反 HNSW 算法要求 ef ≥ 1。这是真缺陷 —— API 应该拒绝非法 ef 值但实际未校验,允许危险参数通过并可能触发 Knowhere 库未定义行为或无效搜索结果。
